name: Scenic Drive RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 33.6121,-85.7241: two gravel loops of RV sites in a wooded hollow beside the road; no water - not waterfront

name: Talladega Creekside Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 300 m frame) at 33.5264,-86.0391: office, cabins and an open lawn on the SW bank of Choccolocco Creek (~25-30 m wide); the RV sites cannot be told apart from the lawn under the trees and a fringe of bank trees lines the creek - defaulted down to not waterfront (creekside/riverfront candidate if a per-site map turns up)

name: Bama Campground & RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 34.2221,-87.4202: gravel lot and buildings in open pasture with a small farm pond ~170 m south of the camping area across open field - not waterfront

name: Unhitched RV Cullman
evidence: satellite (Esri, 300-500 m frames) at 34.2140,-86.9055: rows of pull-through sites in open grass north of a small pond; the one row near the pond is separated from it by a paved road and lawn - not waterfront

name: Logan Valley RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 1.4 km frame) at 34.1508,-87.9804: small gravel lot with RVs beside a building just east of US-43 in Hamilton (much of the frame under cloud); no water near the lot - not waterfront

name: Bama RV Station
evidence: satellite (Esri, 260 m frame) at 33.1834,-87.4612: angled pull-through sites with grass islands behind light-industrial buildings off US-11; no water - not waterfront

name: Riverview Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 34.3813,-86.3458: wooded campground on a Lake Guntersville point with sites under heavy canopy; the operator prices lake-front lots only as seasonal contracts and the short-term sites cannot be located - defaulted down to not waterfront
